capabilities: Sync collectives and pages bidirectionally with a Nextcloud server
Map page hierarchies to vault folders and notes
Resolve edit conflicts with conflict copies and a dialog
Sync page emoji, tags, wikilinks and attachments
Sign in via Nextcloud Login Flow or an app password
extras: Carries a strong data-loss disclaimer advising backups before first sync; the full user manual, troubleshooting and FAQ live outside the README on GitHub; donations via Ko-fi.
problem: Teams using Nextcloud Collectives cannot edit their collective pages from an Obsidian vault, so Obsidian users and browser-based colleagues work on separate copies.

relations.evidence: syncs all Nextcloud Collectives of a Nextcloud server with your vault

requires.name: Nextcloud server with the Collectives app

summary: Two-way sync that mirrors every Collectives wiki of a Nextcloud server as vault folders and notes, including pages, tags, links and attachments.
